description: On the counter there’s a metal tray with a slice of bread and a pink-frosted donut, a clear plastic container with its lid nearby, plus a TV remote, a small cube puzzle, and a tiny bear figurine. The left hand stays resting near the cube on the left, while the right hand moves in from the right to grasp the donut on the tray, lifts it up and over, and places it into the clear plastic container before letting go.
